headline: 今日热搜《末日地堡》领跑，暑期档激烈
headlineEn: Doomsday Bunker tops today's hot searches amid heated summer season
summary: 2026年8月21日，电影市场热度不减：今日3部新片上映，本周共6部新片。热搜由《末日地堡》领跑，《怒之杀》《极昼血祭》紧随其后；《绿灯军团》称霸本周热度榜。
summaryEn: On August 21, 2026, the film market stays hot: 3 new films open today, and 6 this week. Doomsday Bunker leads today's trending, followed by Fury Kill and Polar Day Blood Sacrifice; Green Lantern Corps tops the weekly chart.

industryHighlights.text: 今日3部新片同日上映，市场供给持续加码
industryHighlights.en: Three new films open today, adding to a strong slate

industryHighlights.text: 本周新片达6部，周度热度由《绿灯军团》领衔
industryHighlights.en: Six new films hit theaters this week; Green Lantern Corps leads weekly buzz

industryHighlights.text: 《玩具总动员5》同时登顶今日与本周热搜TOP5
industryHighlights.en: Toy Story 5 appears on both today's and this week's top trending lists

industryHighlights.text: 《最后的日出》即将上映，备受期待
industryHighlights.en: The upcoming release 'The Last Sunrise' is highly anticipated
